title: Depth bound for the parity circuit
statement: For every natural number $n$, the depth of the parity circuit on $n$ Boolean variables is at most $4(\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1)$, with the logarithm interpreted as the natural-number logarithm used in the bound.
